sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-02 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (2026 - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) - (substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) > '09-24') = 25
